responsibility: Implements the small string-keyed red-black tree utility used by the rs6000 builtin generator. It owns node creation, left/right rotations, balanced insertion with duplicate rejection, membership lookup, and inorder traversal/dumping over the rbt_strings/rbt_string_node structures, providing rs6000-gen-builtins.c with an ordered set for builtin IDs and related generated-name bookkeeping during build-time code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the local rbtree pair: it provides the executable string-tree algorithms—node allocation, rotations, balanced insertion, lookup, dumping, and inorder callbacks—while rbtree.h only defines the tree/node structures, color enum, and function declarations used by the builtin generator.
